Eight independent widgets: System Tray (including children and Trash), animated task manager, Downloads, Dock Separator, Start Menu, Analog Clock, Digital Clock and Grid Test.

Run python3 install-widgets.py --check, then python3 install-widgets.py.
The installer reads all five .tar.gz packages and three .plasmoid packages.
This folder is identical to the widgets/ folder inside sequoia-widgets.tar.gz.
Native adapters are checked against the target Qt/KDE before installation.
The grid/picker is a Plasma shell integration, not part of a widget package. For guided presets and snapping, install Plasma style from Sequoia-Eleven-Installer.tar.xz.
Existing desktop clock instances are not migrated by this bundle.
